How the decision works

Evidence becomes a repair.

Each confirmed edge says that a training example and an evaluation example cannot both remain in this candidate release. HOLDOUT uses a weighted bipartite vertex cover, reduced to minimum cut, to choose exclusions with the lowest declared cost.

Why there are two bounds

The lower bound uses confirmed conflicts. The upper bound also treats every unresolved candidate relationship as a conflict. Investigation can close that gap. The guarantee applies to the compiled relationships and policy, not every possible undiscovered source of contamination.

What the agent does

The agent chooses investigations, follows source provenance, and records evidence. The optimizer computes the repair. A recorded replay displays captured results; it does not execute an agent or FalkorDB in your browser.

Use your local backend

Serve this interface from the HOLDOUT backend, then reload. Live controls become available when /api/state responds. See the project README for setup and start commands.
